notifications.title: The Pro plan's usage limit stopped the routines on 24-25 Oct
notifications.detail: The 04:07 IST video run on 24 Oct made 1 of 3 Shorts and ended with 'usage limit reached'; the improver (06:17) and dashboard (07:37) runs on 24 Oct failed for the same reason, and no Short, improver, dashboard or research run happened on 25 Oct. The backlog is 0, so the 24 Oct afternoon and all 25 Oct slots had nothing new. The Studio, Scout and trend routines are disabled (since 23 Oct). The routines were edited on 25 Oct around 13:34 IST and the next video run is due 04:07 IST on 26 Oct.
notifications.fix: 1. On claude.ai, check Settings > Usage to see when the weekly limit resets. 2. If it keeps running out, keep Studio/Scout off and consider moving the improver or dashboard routine to every other day (owner-only schedule change). 3. Never turn on paid usage credits. 4. Check tomorrow that videos/v-20261026-* appear on main.

notifications.title: A published Short shows the same amount two different ways
notifications.detail: v-20261017-04 ('How much do impulse orders really cost you in 15 years?') shows '₹6.5 L gone' at 15.9 s but 'Put in ₹6.4 L' at 26.7 s, and 'Worth ₹16.3 L' at 26.7 s but '₹16.5 L' on the bar at 32.2 s. It is one of the channel's most-viewed videos (284 views). It was made by the old money_leak_meter template, which no longer exists; the adopted same-figure-same-text check stops new videos doing this.
notifications.fix: Only the owner handles uploads: in YouTube Studio, open that Short and either set it to Private/Unlisted or leave it up (the gap is a rounding and convention difference, not a wrong claim). Nothing to change in the repo.

notifications.title: Optional: listen to two better-rated voices for the narrator
notifications.detail: Kokoro's own grades: af_heart A, af_bella A-, bf_emma (British) B-, but am_michael, am_fenrir and am_puck only C+. Voices are picked by your ear, so research hasn't proposed a change.
notifications.fix: 1. On your computer: bash scripts/setup-voice.sh, then make a short sample with bf_emma and am_michael (renderer/engine/voice.py speak_timed). 2. If you like one, ask the improver (or edit NARRATOR_VOICES in renderer/timeline/build.py) to add it. 3. Otherwise ignore this.

notifications.title: YouTube changes Shorts monetisation on 1 Feb 2027
notifications.detail: YouTube's own blog (10 Aug 2026): from 1 Feb 2027 new Partner Program applicants need 8,000 watch hours in 365 days or 20 million Shorts views in 90 days, and Shorts ad/Premium revenue goes only to channels with 10 million Shorts views in the last 90 days. Channels below that keep long-video earnings. For us that means long videos are the realistic path to revenue; Shorts mainly grow the audience. Nothing changes in the pipeline.
notifications.fix: 1. Nothing to do now. 2. In YouTube Studio > Earn, check the current entry bar and whether the channel can apply before 1 Feb 2027. 3. If you want long videos weighted more, change longPerWeek in settings (owner-only). Source: https://blog.youtube/news-and-events/youtube-partner-program-updates-2027-new-opportunities-earn/
